name: eta6de-answer-delivery
goal: Prove recorded Tracker answers reach the correct live agent or trigger recovery and alert Chief of Staff on failure

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Active runner is Harness. Answer mutation records the result in replicated items. Host watchdog sends Hub session messages but never observes answers. Closed-block resume requires local close receipt and a still-blocked item.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Strengthen blocked-run-waits-for-answer in tracker-finished-sessions. Existing test checks eventual restart after a locally recorded close, but never asserts live prompt delivery or recovery when the provider exits before the launcher closes it.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed red 1c02420257: expected blocked to be in_progress; both provider fixtures saw no messages or delivery receipts.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Guard pane identity, persist delivery receipt, expose missing-delivery alert, and reopen current blocked run with gone original session.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged frozen regression passed at cbc9c53dab. Both delivery receipts and the failure alert were produced, and the ended blocked run relaunched. The integrated branch independently passed the extended case.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
